sentences.en: This volcano has been inactive for hundreds of years.
sentences.zh: 这座火山已经几百年的没有活动过了。

sentences.en: You are as inactive as a bagpiper’s pinky.
sentences.zh: 你和风笛手的无名指一样懒散。

sentences.en: The volcano has been inactive for a long time.
sentences.zh: 这座火山很长时间都没有活动过了。

senses.zh: 无行动的, 不活动的, 停止的, 怠惰的。adj.非活动的
